scenes.outline: A copies lifting audition number as confidence signal, B was checking number; A covers and offers door or home while refusing to guarantee no laughter.

A copies chair pulled out as saved place, B moving it for passage; A covers and reveals reunion wait, then fear B preferred absence.
A copies zeroing calculator as accounts completed; B actual zero takings; A covers and invites owner to stop smiling for employee.
A copies leaving TV on as sociable-home custom, B reveals loneliness; A covers and seeks invitation without cheerful performance.
A copies crossing map route as fair cancellation, B marked flooded shortcut; A covers and calls panic a transport hiccup while replacing vans.
A copies emptying envelope as accounted balance, B moved cash to bank bag; A covers and suppresses earlier theft accusation while updating committee.
A copies sugar stirring as readiness despite not wanting sugar; B clarifies own cup, then offers swap; A covers and turns swap into labeling rather than opening letter.
A copies folding ticket as boarding validation, B folded receipt to fit wallet; A covers and asks barrier details, then questions B ticket instead of fear.
